build_faster_rcnn_detector: build a FasterRCNN detector with backbone, rpn_head, roi_head, train_cfg, and test_cfg config dicts
train_faster_rcnn: train the FasterRCNN two-stage detector using forward_train with ground truth bounding boxes and labels
test_faster_rcnn_simple: test the FasterRCNN detector on images using simple_test without test-time augmentation
test_faster_rcnn_aug: test the FasterRCNN detector with test-time augmentation using aug_test on multiple augmented images
extract_faster_rcnn_features: extract backbone and neck features from input images using the extract_feat method
